name: hh-meanrev-micro: washout snapback liquidation fade (5m core)
rationale: MECHANISM: in a forced-liquidation cascade the margin engine is a PRICE-INSENSITIVE seller — it dumps at market to protect the insurance fund, driving price transiently below fair value. The other side is the market-maker / arbitrageur who provides liquidity into the panic and captures the snapback as forced flow exhausts. The edge persists because crypto leverage is structural and 24/7, cascades recur (Oct 10-11 2025 wiped $19B in 36h), and the price-insensitive seller is not competing on price, so the fader is paid to warehouse inventory for minutes. Entry: bb_z at a fitted multi-sigma washout AND rsi deeply oversold (a genuine capitulation, not routine noise). Long-only spot; exit as bb_z reverts toward the band basis. DISCONFIRMER: if per-symbol net-of-fee PnL is flat/negative once real taker fees + spread are charged on every entry (a ~0.4% 5m bounce sits inside the round-trip cost on all but the most liquid pairs), OR the win-rate on the washout events is no better than a random long at the same timestamps, the overshoot is just correctly-priced bad news continuing down — kill. Hard test: exclude the top-5 liquidation days; if the whole edge lives in <5 tail events it is regime luck, not a repeatable snapback.
catalyst: multi-sigma forced-liquidation washout that snaps back as price-insensitive flow exhausts
